# bufo (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    bufo = {
      source = "austinvalle/bufo"
    }
  }
}

resource "bufo" "test1" {
  name = "bufo-the-builder"
  list_block { both_attr = "set by config!" }
  list_block {} # Provider will set both_attr
}

resource "bufo" "test2" {
  name = "bufo-the-builder"
  single_block {
    both_attr = "set by config!"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the bufo.

### Optional

- `list_block` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--list_block))
- `single_block` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--single_block))
